{{Quote|This place was a graveyard world, littered with the remains of giant, extinct beings. We didn't want our bones to join them, but the situation looked grim. If this was going to be the Renegade Squadron's last stand, then we were going to make the Empire remember it.|Commander Col Serra|<ref name="SWBRS" />}}
The '''Battle of Boz Pity''' took place around [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The battle occurred when the Empire discovered the Alliance's new [[Boz Pity base|main base]] on Boz Pity, through a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] had [[Mission to Mos Eisley (Galactic Civil War)|planted]] in an [[R5-series astromech droid|R5 droid]] captured by the Alliance. With this information, the Empire launched a full-scale assault on the Boz Pity base, sending a large [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to destroy the Alliance forces stationed there. Once the Imperial fleet emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] over Boz Pity, it landed several ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] to assault the base. The Alliance's new elite fighting force, [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]]&mdash;led by the [[Commander/Legends|Commanders]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Col Serra]]&mdash;defended the base's main gate from the invading Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], while the rest of the Rebels stationed on Boz Pity were able to evacuate.

Although the Renegades were able to destroy an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] and several [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] walkers using [[particle cannon turret]]s and explosives, the advancing Imperial forces eventually overpowered Renegade Squadron, forcing Solo to order the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] to fall back to the rear of the base. There, the Rebels held out against the Empire's superior numbers until they were able to evacuate Boz Pity via [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|It was a trap, and we walked right into it!|Commander Serra|<ref name="SWBRS" />}}
[[File:BozPityconcept.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Alliance's new base on Boz Pity]]
Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]]<ref name="Date" />&mdash;during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]&mdash;the Alliance secretly set up a new [[Boz Pity base|main base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]]<ref name="SWBRS" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> shortly after being forced to [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuate]] its [[Great Temple/Legends|previous base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]]&mdash;the Alliance's new elite fighting force composed of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], formed and led by former [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Commander/Legends|Commanders]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Col Serra]]&mdash;was able to [[Mission to Mos Eisley (Galactic Civil War)|free]] a number of Rebel [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] being held by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWBRS" />

While the Renegades escaped Tatooine to the Alliance base on Boz Pity with their liberated comrades, the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] also brought back an [[R5-series astromech droid|R5-series droid]] it had captured. However, unbeknownst to Renegade Squadron, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], out to collect the Empire's [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] for information on the Rebel Alliance, had installed a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] into the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. With this information, the Empire launched a full scale invasion of the Rebels' base. A few [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after Renegade Squadron arrived at Boz Pity, an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] over the planet.<ref name="SWBRS" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|It was only a couple of hours after our arrival at Boz Pity that an Imperial planetary assault force descended on us.|Commander Serra|<ref name="SWBRS" />}}
[[File:BozPitytres.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Renegade Squadron holds the Empire back.]]
With their base compromised, Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] quickly ordered an evacuation of Boz Pity, with some Rebels using their tamed [[carrion spat]] pack animals as transports to easily traverse the base. However, the Imperials soon landed ground forces on the planet, hoping to halt the Alliance's escape. As the Imperial ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]], [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], and [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] approached the Rebel base, Renegade Squadron was tasked with holding off the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] while the rest of the Alliance's personnel made it off the planet. Serra, realizing that the Renegades would not likely survive the battle, planned to slow the Empire's advance by any means necessary. Serra ordered his squadron to capture and hold the base's main gate, the only entrance into the base. With the gate secure, the Renegades were able to repel the first wave of Imperials, destroying an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] several Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="SWBRS" />

However, as the second wave of Imperials approached&mdash;which included many more stormtroopers and an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]]&mdash;Serra realized that the Rebels were not strong enough to defend the main gate and ordered Renegade Squadron to fall back deeper into the base. Solo placed a container of [[Thermal bomb|thermal explosives]] at the side of the gate house and told one of his men to place a [[Detonation pack|detpack]] next to the container. As the Empire's AT-AT arrived at the main gate, the Rebels triggered the detpack and the thermal explosives. The resulting explosion blew out the AT-AT's forward two legs, causing the walker to crash down. With the walker destroyed, the Imperials were forced to fall back and regroup.<ref name="SWBRS" />

The temporary Imperial retreat bought the Renegades some [[Time/Legends|time]], and Solo ordered his squadron to set up a pair of [[particle cannon turret]]s and several [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] as the Imperials launched their third attack wave, with two AT-STs in front of the assault. As the Imperials moved deeper into the Rebel base, however, they experienced heavy fire from Renegade Squadron's turrets and suffered several casualties, including the AT-STs.<ref name="SWBRS" />

Though Renegade Squadron had destroyed the first few attack waves, more and more Imperial stormtroopers flooded into the base. During the resulting [[Lightfight|firefight]], Ackbar was shot by an Imperial [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] and injured. Hearing the news, Solo ordered a member of Renegade Squadron to bring a [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] container to the injured admiral. After being partially healed, Ackbar was able to make his way to the evacuation zone.<ref name="SWBRS" />

[[File:BattleOfBozPity-GalacticCivilWar.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Imperials attack the sacrificial chamber.]]
It soon became obvious to the Rebels that the Boz Pity base was lost, as the Imperials were now deploying more AT-ST walkers and pushing back the Renegades. The Empire managed to capture the Rebels' particle turrets and [[Laser/Legends|laser]] cannons, using them against the retreating Alliance troops. Solo ordered Renegade Squadron to the evacuation zone, an ancient sacrificial circle at rear of the base, and to defend the area as he prepared several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] for launch. Using [[T4-B heavy tank]]s for support, the Renegades held off the enemy advance for a few [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]]. Finally, Solo was able to get the [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] ready for liftoff, and Renegade Squadron escaped Boz Pity and the Imperial fleet.<ref name="SWBRS" />

==Aftermath==
Although the Alliance lost Boz Pity to the Empire, Renegade Squadron and most of the Alliance's personnel there successfully made it off the planet and evaded the Empire. Soon after the battle, Rebel Commander [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] discovered the remote [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], which would serve as the Rebels' [[Echo Base/Legends|new main base]]<ref name="SWBRS" /> until [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Renegade Squadron would continue to serve the Alliance, making several hit-and-run attacks against the Empire over the next few years.<ref name="SWBRS" />

Years later, after the defeat of the Empire and the formation of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tionne Solusar]] of the [[New Jedi Order]] tracked down Col Serra&mdash;who by then had retired from military service&mdash;to ask him about Renegade Squadron for her [[Jedi Archives/Legends|archives]]. Serra told Solusar about many of their battles and missions, including the Renegades' defense of Boz Pity.<ref name="SWBRS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle's first appearance to date is in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''&mdash;released [[October 9]], [[2007]]&mdash;which tells the history and feats of Renegade Squadron. The battle itself makes up the game's sixth campaign level, in which the player, a member of Renegade Squadron, assists in the defense of the Boz Pity base. In the level, the player must help defend the main gate, destroy the AT-AT walker, heal Ackbar, and protect the evacuation zone as the Rebels retreat.

The video game mistakenly states that Boz Pity is in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], when in fact the planet is in the Mid Rim, according to the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 9|Part 9]] of [[The Official Star Wars Fact File (2014)|''The Official Star Wars Fact File''{{'s}} second edition]] was the first to give the battle a [[canon]] name.
